resource_container.status: Not a concrete C++ lifetime implementation; no no-op notification or simple pointer-vector erase is an acceptable substitute. Nested helper cleanup bodies are not fully reconstructed by this discovery.

array_contracts.reserve: 00B3D9B0 clamps signed requested capacity to at least one; if growing, allocate N*8, copy raw current records, free old storage, then publish pointer/capacity. No reference increments.
array_contracts.resize: 00B3DA20 grows storage if needed, initializes each new record to two zero DWORDs, shrinks only count, then writes requested count. No reference release.
array_contracts.destroy: 00B3EC40 calls resize zero then frees current data; data/capacity fields remain stale.

getter.abi: ECX texture; stack mip and unused DWORD; RET 8; EAX owned native surface.
getter.hit: Captured data and count search. Increment cached actual owner count before pointer null check; null record is not a safe miss.
getter.miss: GetSurfaceLevel overwrites original first argument word. Actual surface pool allocation and complete surface constructor consume current flags and flags-bit-8 kind. Drop COM getter reference after constructor.
getter.cache_gate: Reload current texture flags after getter Release. If bit zero clear, increment actual surface count for cache ownership BEFORE possible reserve; append actual key/pointer. If bit zero set, leave uncached creator reference for caller.
getter.count_domains: Returned caller reference and cached owner reference are distinct; actual surface zero route is completed native surface destructor and canonical surface-pool return.
getter.exception_boundary: Only construction-period raw slot return in state zero. No GetSurfaceLevel COM release in EH; state becomes -1 before normal getter Release. A later cache reserve throw happens after the intended cache retain and has no local rollback.

cached_surfaces.destructor_callback_boundary: Capture &old_data[i].surface before zero dispatch and clear that exact slot address afterward, while reloading array data and live count for each next iteration.

reset.release: 00B3DD30 signed live record loop invokes each current surface virtual+3C, then captured texture COM pair and fresh final COM Release/null; source and actual surface wrappers remain retained.
reset.recreate: 00B3DD90 CreateTexture uses current metadata, publishes/retains new before releasing old, drops getter reference even for identity, then rebinds existing cached wrappers using GetSurfaceLevel and current virtual+14. It allocates no new wrapper and changes no wrapper count.
reset.callback_reloads: Each reset-loop iteration reads current array data/key; after GetSurfaceLevel, it reloads current array data to select the surface wrapper. Counts are live signed bounds, not snapshots.

exact_stack_aliases.output: GetSurfaceLevel writes original first stack argument word, initially the mip DWORD; mip is captured separately in EBX.
CreateTexture writes original input-device stack word, initially the device pointer; device is captured in EAX before call.
Per-level GetSurfaceLevel output is the first pushed ECX word, initially owner identity, later preceding getter result; it is not reset to null.

reset.failure_domain: HRESULT ignored; omitted/partial output writes are not made safe by any native nullable-local guard. Low flags nibble outside 0..3 uses incoming device pointer bits as pool fallback. Current typed reset rejects invalid pool, guards ownership and reports HRESULT instead.

source_assignment.native_abi: ECX destination pointer slot; EDX source pointer slot; EAX destination; RET.
source_assignment.order: Identity skip; publish new, retain actual count, then decrement old and dispatch current virtual zero if zero.

zero_chain: ordinary free if deleting flag bit zero
stream.destruction: Release actual backing; clear +8 after callback; stream/base profile cleanup; preserve end/cursor.

backing.allocation: Native BF55BE array allocation of positive signed request, or one byte with stored length zero for nonpositive request.
backing.counters: Actual 0109DB98 object count increments after allocation; actual 0109DB9C adds original signed request. Destruction frees data first, decrements count and subtracts stored length; no data/length clearing.
zero_chain: free data / update counters / base / optional ordinary backing free

retained_source.retained_recreation: 00B3E190 queries current stream virtual+30 size, reloads texture+4C for BEF610 base data, independently of cursor, then calls D3DX with direct owner+10 output. Wrapper and backing must remain concrete and retained across calls.
retained_source.cpp_boundary: Existing MemoryStream and D3D9RetainedTexture2D are useful shared_ptr semantic projections with initialized-data checks. Their headers explicitly omit native allocator/counters/intrusive ABI. They do not prove the actual source-owner zero chain.

supporting_current_assembly.role: Stream destructor unwind base helper; inspected through target-verified Ghidra disasm, not counted as a separately byte-compared range.
Logical texture base unwind helper; same direct disassembly evidence boundary.

interpretation: Texture destructor state1 array storage -> state0 logical base; no resumed surface loop, second COM release or second source release during unwind.
Unnamed ctor: diagnostic record -> temporary name -> cache storage -> logical base. Named ctor: diagnostic record -> cache storage -> logical base. No acquired COM release in either map.
Cached surface getter state0 returns raw surface pool slot only; it does not run a complete surface destructor or Release its COM getter on that exception.
Pool constructor: table -> actual critical section -> actual shared allocator base. Allocator body has no lock-unwind map.
Memory backing constructor unwind is base only. Memory wrapper destructor unwind installs stream base then refcounted base.

contract: No texture, COM, source-stream, cache-array or renderer-container construction/deletion in this pool packet.
Initialize slab free WORD indices 31..0 and all 32 actual trailing IDs; leave all texture bytes and final slab padding untouched.
Return reads actual +50h slab ID and divides raw slot difference by 54h; append index, update first free if lower; actual lock/counter ordering.
Trim performs swap-last slab compaction and rewrites all 32 trailing IDs of the moved slab, including occupied slots; recheck replaced slot and recompute first-free.
Destructor frees slabs/table before draining actual positive recursion, deletes lock, then unlinks real allocator element; it invokes no texture destructor.
Constructor EH map/complete post-free stack-cleanup tails must be retained. Static init is 22 bytes at CD7B60 despite missing current Ghidra function; register actual CE0CA0 thunk.
